metadata.title: शिल्पी नेहा तिर्की: तेज़तर्रार आदिवासी विधायक | Shilpi Neha Tirkey: A powerful voice of adivasis
metadata.description: Join us for a compelling conversation as MBB editor Chitrita Sanyal sits down with Shilpi Neha Tirkey, the dynamic MLA representing the Mandar constituency in Jharkhand. A seasoned marketing professional turned political leader, Tirkey is a prominent advocate for tribal communities in the Jharkhand Assembly. In this candid interview held in Ranchi, Tirkey discusses pressing issues facing Adivasis, sheds light on the targeting of Chief Minister Hemant Soren by investigating agencies, and shares insights into her interactions with Congress leader Rahul Gandhi. Don't miss this enlightening discussion on the challenges and aspirations of tribal populations in Jharkhand. Watch the full interview now for invaluable perspectives on tribal rights and representation.
